about: Elliot Lake is a city in Northern Ontario’s Algoma District, on the Canadian Shield north of Lake Huron’s North Channel. Uranium mining built the community; after the mines closed it reinvented itself as a retirement and outdoor-recreation city among lakes and forests. About 11,000 people live in Elliot Lake.
seoSummary: Algoma District Shield city north of the North Channel—uranium-mining heritage reinvented as a lakes-and-forest community.
